question: What does a Nimbus API 409 Conflict response mean?
support_id_validation_result: E1.S5 application-owned ID accepted; raw model IDs unavailable
citation_resolution_result: E1.S5 resolved; model source-like text not authoritative
visible_answer: 409 means a uniqueness-constraint conflict; 422 is schema validation failure; extra model source-like text was also visible
notes: The visible result contains valid application citation E1.S5 and an additional source-like model string. No evidence shows that the model string was accepted as a support identity.
